high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from Mufaddal Vohra (@mufaddal_vohra) on Twitter. The tweet was posted 4 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The tweet reads: "Rachin Ravindra said, 'Virat Kohli is a great player, he played a marvelous knock today'." Below the tweet, there is an embedded video thumbnail. The video shows a man in a white cricket uniform holding a microphone with a blue cover. He appears to be speaking or laughing, as his mouth is open and his expression is cheerful. The background behind him is a wall
